title: 电动送风过滤式呼吸器

points.K12: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室更衣间，手捧一个白色送风头盔，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a laboratory changing room holding a white powered air hood helmet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学穿送风式呼吸头罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着头盔、电池、腰带三样东西
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a helmet, a battery pack and a belt laid on a bench.
shots.narration: 顺序错一步，都可能出危险。

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白通知，第一次要进高等级实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank notice, preparing to enter a high containment laboratory for the first time.
shots.narration: 小研第一次要用送风头罩。

shots.scene: 小研拿起头盔左看右看，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the helmet around with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 这么多部件，先装哪个？

shots.scene: 穿短袖T恤的老李推着设备车进来，要亲自示范
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves wheels an equipment cart in, ready to demonstrate on himself.
shots.narration: 老李穿上身，给她示范一遍。

shots.scene: 老李手指头盔顶部的过滤器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points to the filter mounted on top of the helmet.
shots.narration: 头盔里装着过滤器，能挡住病原。

shots.scene: 头盔、头罩、电池、腰带四个部件摆开
shots.prompt_en: Four parts laid out on a bench: a helmet, a soft shroud, a battery pack and a belt. No people.
shots.narration: 头盔、头罩、电池、腰带，一整套。

shots.scene: 老李把白色披肩头罩从头盔上取下又装回
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer detaches the white shroud from the helmet and attaches it again.
shots.narration: 外面这层披肩头罩，可以更换。

shots.scene: 示意图：空气从头盔侧面吸入，经过滤器，向下吹过面部
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of air drawn in from the side of the helmet, passing a filter and flowing downward over the face. No people.
shots.narration: 空气从侧面吸进，过滤后吹向脸部。

shots.scene: 头罩内气流箭头向下、向外
shots.prompt_en: Arrows inside the hood flowing down and out under the shroud. No people.
shots.narration: 向下的气流，把脏空气挡在外面。

shots.scene: 电池组和连接线图标
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack icon with a connecting cable. No people.
shots.narration: 风机靠电池带动。

shots.scene: 老李把腰带系在自己腰上，调好松紧，小研在旁看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves fastens a belt around his own waist and adjusts it while the female graduate student watches.
shots.narration: 第一步，先系好腰带。

shots.scene: 穿上防护服后手够不到腰带的示意，问号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a person in a protective suit unable to reach the belt underneath, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 穿上防护服，就够不着了。

shots.scene: 电池放在充电座上，指示灯满格
shots.prompt_en: A battery pack on a charging dock showing a full charge indicator. No people.
shots.narration: 每次实验前，电池要充满。

shots.scene: 老李把电池卡进自己腰带上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves clips the battery pack firmly onto his belt.
shots.narration: 把电池牢牢装在腰带上。

shots.scene: 头罩上一滩液体溢洒的图标
shots.prompt_en: A shroud with a liquid spill mark on it. No people.
shots.narration: 头罩去污后可以再用。

shots.scene: 沾了溢洒的头罩放进生物危害废物袋，新头罩换上
shots.prompt_en: A spill-stained shroud goes into a biohazard waste bag and a fresh shroud is fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 可一旦沾上溢洒，就换新的。

shots.scene: 老李转动头盔内的头箍旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves turns the headband adjustment knob inside the helmet.
shots.narration: 调节头箍，让它稳稳贴住额头。

shots.scene: 老李把电源线插到电池和头盔上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves plugs the cable into the battery and the helmet.
shots.narration: 戴上之前，先插好电源线。

shots.scene: 不通电就戴上头罩的图标被打叉，旁边红色警示
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person wearing an unpowered hood, crossed out with a red X and a red warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 不送风戴着头罩，会喘不上气！

shots.scene: 电池上三个指示灯全部亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three indicator lights all turn on on the battery pack. No people.
shots.narration: 开机，看指示灯是不是全亮。

shots.scene: 电池图标和时钟
shots.prompt_en: A battery icon beside a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 这款电池约用六小时，再充电。

shots.scene: 老李双手戴上头盔，披肩垂到T恤上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves puts the helmet on with both hands and the shroud drapes over his shirt.
shots.narration: 风机转着，戴上头盔。

shots.scene: 老李系紧颈部的带子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves tightens the straps around his neck.
shots.narration: 系紧带子，披肩盖住肩膀。

shots.scene: 老李慢慢转一圈，小研帮他看前后
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves turns around slowly while the female graduate student checks front and back.
shots.narration: 转一圈，前后都检查到位。

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 老李站着，头盔里风机仍在转
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves stands still with the helmet fan still running.
shots.narration: 脱的时候，风机先别关。
overlay: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 老李双手托住头盔后部，向上向前摘下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves lifts the helmet off from the back with both hands
shots.narration: 先把头盔摘下来。

shots.section_title: 脱下：风机转着摘，再断电
shots.scene: 摘下后，才拔下电源线
shots.prompt_en: After the helmet is off, the power cable is unplugged. No people.
shots.narration: 摘下来以后，再断开电池。

shots.scene: 头盔放在托盘上，用消毒湿巾擦拭表面
shots.prompt_en: A helmet on a tray being wiped with disinfectant wipes by a bare hand.
shots.narration: 每次用完，表面去污。

shots.scene: 老李空手用消毒湿巾擦头盔表面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a short-sleeved T-shirt and no gloves wipes the helmet surface with disinfectant wipes.
shots.narration: 用推荐的消毒剂擦表面。

shots.scene: 旧头罩放进废物袋，换上新头罩
shots.prompt_en: An old shroud goes into a waste bag and a new shroud is fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时，换上新头罩。

shots.scene: 电池放回充电座，日历上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The battery pack is placed back on the charging dock with a calendar tick. No people.
shots.narration: 用完马上充电，下次才放心。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁一排步骤图标：腰带、电池、头箍、插电、灯亮、系带
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of step icons: belt, battery, headband, plug, lights and straps.
shots.narration: 腰带、电池、头箍、先插电，再戴上。

shots.scene: 电池三灯全亮和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: Three battery lights on beside a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 开机看灯全亮，续航约六小时。

shots.scene: 风机转着摘头盔、再断电的两格图
shots.prompt_en: Two panels: removing the helmet with the fan on, then unplugging the cable. No people.
shots.narration: 脱时风机先转着，摘下再断电。

shots.scene: 擦拭头盔和充电座两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: wiping a helmet and a charging dock. No people.
shots.narration: 用后表面去污，然后充电。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、老李一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the female graduate student and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 一步步穿对，安全才有保障，再见！
